TRANSACTION - FUNCTIONAL DESCRIPTION: transaction transaction to obtain a price rule by your id
EXECUTION FLOWS - DETAILED DESCRIPTION: 1. Input and validations: execute() obtains pricingRuleId through getPricingruleid() and validates whether pricingRuleId is not null and lower than 0. 2. Decisions and branches: when pricingRuleId != null && pricingRuleId < 0, execute() adds advice ABKO00000050 with warning severity and continues; after calling the library, when priceRule == null, execute() adds advice ABKO00000040 with warning severity and continues. 3. Invoked libraries and methods: execute() calls ABKOR000.executeGetPricingRuleById(pricingRuleId); ABKOR000Impl.executeGetPricingRuleById delegates to callPricingRuleByIdDataBase, which builds base query parameters, adds pricingRuleId, executes the database query, returns null when no rows are found, maps the first row through mapToPricingRuleGetDTO, and then sets proggresiveType, precedence, parentPricingRuleId, version, and comment. mapToPricingRuleGetDTO maps the main pricing rule fields, builds effectiveDate and fee, derives activity from mapActivities, maps segment and settlement through mapRelatedEntity, and loads paymentMethods and customAttributes through Utils list mappers. 4. Errors and subsequent actions: execute() emits ABKO00000050 when pricingRuleId is non-null and negative, based on the local validation before the library call; execute() emits ABKO00000040 when ABKOR000.executeGetPricingRuleById returns null after the query finds no rows. 5. Outputs and assignment conditions: execute() always calls setPricingrule(priceRule), so pricingRule is assigned with the PricingRuleGetDTO returned by the library or with null when no row is found.

Accessed Libraries.Description: Retrieves a pricing rule by its identifier by querying the database with pricingRuleId, mapping the first returned row to PricingRuleGetDTO, and returning null when no rows are found.

Error Management.Description of the error situation: Invalid parameter: pricingRuleId must be non-negative.
